spec_match.rationale: The page's central claim — no window.SpeechRecognitionResult constructor to probe, so only a live result instance can be inspected — was independently re-verified in this session's browser ('SpeechRecognitionResult' in window === false while SpeechRecognition/webkitSpeechRecognition exist), and the nullable and 2 ms fuzzing contracts match the explainer.

interactive.rationale: A static surface probe fills a three-column table and a live inspection runs a real recognition, reporting absent vs null vs populated attributes with honest error paths for headless/blocked-mic environments.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index blurb promises the no-constructor trap, the nullable contract, and the fuzzing note — all present and correct.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes property-absent vs null-value vs populated, covers no-SR browsers, recognition errors, and start() throwing, and warns that null is not 'unsupported'.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus 5811907077472256 (verified) and the explainer's security/privacy anchor are linked.

conformance.rationale: The suite is all-manual, which is honest: the attributes exist only on live result objects and the suite explicitly forbids fabricating or inferring timestamps, matching this page's teaching.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI: initial states and banner verified, console clean (fonts.googleapis.com failure environmental), and the LegacyNoInterfaceObject claim was confirmed with a scripted probe in the same browser; the page's own buttons could not be clicked here.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts cover probe runs, no-SR, live-result inspection outcomes, and recognition errors, plus injected global error capture.

design_system.rationale: Variables, correct button/secondary overrides, focus-visible outlines, and fixed-layout tables with overflow-wrap; only the small emerald/rose yes/no text (~4.1:1) is marginal.

accessibility.rationale: The live output is an aria-live <output>, pres are keyboard-scrollable, and the table has a caption, but the static-probe table repopulates with no announcement, so probe results arrive silently for screen-reader users.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Harness-validated ok/ok recorded in responsive-support.json (2026-07-25); table-layout:fixed plus overflow-wrap:anywhere handles narrow widths; this session's own 360px CLI capture is inconclusive due to the headless min-width clamp.

openQuestions.title: Announce static-probe results
openQuestions.detail: Pressing 'Probe the surface' replaces the table body silently. Add a brief role=status summary ('3 checks: SpeechRecognition yes, webkitSpeechRecognition yes, SpeechRecognitionResult global no') or aria-live on the caption so non-visual users get the outcome.

openQuestions.title: Nudge the yes/no verdict colours to AA
openQuestions.detail: The .yes emerald (#0a8f5c) on bg-paper measures ~4.1:1 at table-cell size, just under the 4.5:1 bar (rose passes). Shared design-system tweak with other pages using small emerald text.

summary: An unusually rigorous capability page: its no-constructor trap, bad-vs-good detection recipes, and nullable semantics were all re-verified against this session's browser (SpeechRecognitionResult is indeed absent from window in Chromium 141 while the recognizer constructors exist), and the all-manual conformance suite honestly refuses to fabricate timing. Remaining items are minor announcement and contrast polish. Verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshots, DOM, scripted global-exposure probe, clean console); buttons could not be clicked in this environment.
